name: Aimplifi
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm install 24 && nvm use 24 && mkdir -p /usr/local/cargo/bin && NODE24_BIN="$(dirname "$(nvm which 24)")" && ln -sf "$NODE24_BIN/node" /usr/local/cargo/bin/node && ln -sf "$NODE24_BIN/npm" /usr/local/cargo/bin/npm && ln -sf "$NODE24_BIN/npx" /usr/local/cargo/bin/npx && npm ci
